name: RC-B10-0146/2025/REV1 – After § 14 – Am 52/2
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the white paper on the future of European defence
part_text: 14a. Recalls the provisional measures ordered by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) regarding the application of the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide in the Gaza Strip (South Africa v. Israel); stresses the need for international law to be upheld and respected; calls on the Council and the Commission to ensure that the EU is in no way complicit in violations of international law, including under the Convention on the Prevention and Punishment of the Crime of Genocide, with particular regard to the role of the European arms industry in providing weapons to the Israel Defense Forces;
